query:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS restaurant_reservations;

CREATE TABLE restaurant_reservations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  reference VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  restaurant_reservation_type ENUM('particulier', 'entreprise', 'groupe') NOT NULL,
  slotId INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  restaurant_display_choice ENUM('brasserie', 'jardin') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jardin',
  seatsTotal INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(320),
  companyName VARCHAR(255),
  groupName VARCHAR(255),
  groupType VARCHAR(50),
  restaurant_reservation_status ENUM('pending_validation', 'validated_pending_payment', 'paid_confirmed', 'refused', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'no_show') DEFAULT 'pending_validation' NOT NULL,
  restaurant_payment_status ENUM('not_requested', 'pending_payment', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded') DEFAULT 'not_requested' NOT NULL,
  paymentAmount DECIMAL(10, 2),
  paymentProvider VARCHAR(50),
  paymentReference VARCHAR(100),
  qrToken VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE,
  restaurant_qr_status ENUM('inactive', 'active', 'used', 'revoked') DEFAULT 'inactive',
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  processedBy INT,
  processedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
